title: Good-Standing Payments on a Delinquent Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Terms.** A tenant brings a delinquent Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement back to good standing with one payment the tenant authorizes over the phone, applied only to that agreement; the payment returns the agreement to active status and clears its delinquency date. A payment that replaces a payment the bank returned is not a good-standing payment, even where the return has left the agreement delinquent: it is priced as the replacement of that returned payment.

| Payment | Good-standing payment |
|---|---|
| one phone payment by the tenant bringing a delinquent agreement back to good standing | yes |
| a payment replacing a payment the bank returned | no — it is the replacement of that returned payment |

## The tenant's payment tool

The payment is made with `restore_unit_good_standing_afa2c723`, which the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the tenant authorizes the payment from the tenant's own card or bank account. One call records one payment on the agreement's tenant ledger, dated today and taken through the care center phone line, lowers the agreement's balance due by the amount paid, returns the agreement to active status and clears its delinquency date; any part of the payment above the balance due stays on the agreement as a credit balance toward the next rent.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_id` | the storage unit rental agreement number the payment is for, as the agent reads it from the rental agreement lookup and passes it to the tenant | identifier |
| `payment_method` | how the tenant pays | enum: `credit_card` (a credit card the tenant reads out), `debit_card` (a debit card the tenant reads out), `ach_bank_account` (a one-time debit from a bank account the tenant reads out), `cash` (handed over only at a facility office), `money_order` (handed over only at a facility office), `prepaid_rent_plan` (a month applied from a Bluegate prepaid rent plan, never a phone payment) |
| `amount` | the amount the tenant pays, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, always positive; more places are rounded to the cent |

**Return.** The call succeeds when the receipt returns the new payment entry number: `entry_id`, `rental_id`, `payment_method`, `amount`, `entry_date` (today), `balance_due` (after the payment; negative means a credit balance) and `status` (the agreement's standing after the payment, active).

## What the tenant sees
The payment, the new balance and the active standing appear on the agreement's ledger and statement.
